einzeiler: James Acaster joins for the 400th episode to discuss his favourite television shows.
kurzfassung: Brett Goldstein celebrates the 400th episode of his podcast by welcoming back recurring guest James Acaster for a special television-themed edition. Instead of discussing films, the two comedians debate their favourite, scariest, and most disappointing TV series. Throughout the conversation, Acaster shares personal anecdotes about his comedy tour, his five cats, and his unique viewing habits.
stichpunkte: James Acaster returns as the 400th-episode guest, participating in a special TV-focused format called The Black Lodge.
Acaster discusses his current tour performing as a tribute act of himself named Craig Simons.
He shares memories of watching The Animals of Farthing Wood as a child and learning harsh lessons about mortality.
The conversation covers terrifying television moments, specifically highlighting a brutal episode of The Walking Dead.
Acaster defends his controversial opinions on popular prestige television, dismissing both The Sopranos and Heroes.
He praises quirky ensemble shows like Sense8 and the perfection of Pen15 and Fargo's second season.
The episode concludes with promotional details for Acaster's upcoming comedy special and Goldstein's brief hiatus.

clips.hook: Dressed as a terrible tribute act
clips.text: The comedian describes his stage outfit for his current live tour, which includes oversized spiky hair and a flashy red jacket.

clips.hook: A brutal turning point in television
clips.text: A character meets a horrific end when an antagonist repeatedly strikes him with a barbed-wire baseball bat.
The guest explains why he and his partner abandoned a famous mob drama during lockdown because the narrative constantly reset itself.

clips.hook: Appreciating natural male bodies on screen
clips.text: The discussion turns to the rarity of male actors keeping their chest hair in television shows instead of waxing like dolphins.

clips.hook: The ethical darkness of talent shows
clips.text: A major reality competition franchise is criticized for exploiting vulnerable and deluded participants for entertainment before discarding them.

beschreibung:
LOOK OUT! It’s only Films To Be Buried With!

Join your host Brett Goldstein as he talks life, death, love and the universe (for a fourth time) with the genie himself, long term friend and comic / actor / podcaster JAMES ACASTER! The BLACK LODGE!

(...Also known as TV TO BE BURIED WITH). It was long journey getting here, but a glorious one. With the family tradition of Films To Be Buried With having James as guest every 100 episodes, James has basically mentioned every single film in celluloid memory and as such, we find ourselves at The Black Lodge. In other words, every answer is a TV show. A perfect tweak to the format with some answers you may expect but some that will come from straight out of left field. James is always a good time so you'll certainly enjoy this one. We'll see him again in 100 more, but for now, enjoy THE BLACK LODGE!
